4,700 students evacuated in minutes after earthquake hits Yunnan, China
A 4.8-magnitude earthquake hit during class hours in Ludian County, China's Yunnan.
All 4,700 students at a local high school first took cover and then evacuated to safety in an orderly manner within minutes. #China #earthquake #SchoolSafety
